description: Sub-feature of Feature 2. Adds the Plaid Link flow so Eric and Alex can connect real bank accounts from the browser. Includes Link token creation, public_token exchange, OAuth callback for Chase/CapOne/etc., account owner assignment, and a settings page for managing linked institutions. Depends on Cloudflare Tunnel (Appendix A) for OAuth institutions.

timing.gatingCondition: Feature 2 merged to main. Cloudflare Tunnel configured on erebor (see APPENDIX-A-oauth-callback.md). Plaid production credentials in .env.

principles: Minimal public surface — only /oauth/callback exposed via Cloudflare Tunnel, everything else Tailscale-only
Secrets invariant — link_tokens and public_tokens are ephemeral and short-lived, but still never logged
Owner assignment at link time — Eric or Alex picks who owns each linked institution's accounts
Idempotent re-linking — if an Item errors out, re-link replaces the old access_token cleanly
Sandbox-first — full flow testable in sandbox mode before switching to production

userStories.title: Link token creation + Plaid Link initialization
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/link/create-token returns a link_token for Plaid Link
Plaid Link JS SDK loaded from CDN in settings page
Link opens in modal, user completes institution login
Products requested: transactions, liabilities
link_token includes redirect_uri for OAuth institutions
link_token stored in link_sessions table with expiry for OAuth resume

userStories.title: Public token exchange + Item storage
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/link/exchange receives public_token from Plaid Link onSuccess
Exchanges public_token for access_token + item_id via Plaid API
Stores new Item in items table (access_token, item_id, institution_id, institution_name)
Fetches and stores initial accounts immediately after exchange
Triggers initial sync for the new Item
Returns success with institution name and account count

userStories.title: OAuth callback handler
acceptanceCriteria: GET /oauth/callback receives oauth_state_id from Plaid redirect
Looks up pending link session by oauth_state_id
Serves a minimal HTML page that re-initializes Plaid Link with receivedRedirectUri
Plaid Link completes in-browser, fires onSuccess with public_token
Redirects to settings page after successful exchange
Handles error/expiry gracefully with user-friendly message

userStories.title: Settings page — linked institutions management
acceptanceCriteria: New settings.html page linked from main dashboard
Shows all linked Items: institution name, status, last sync, account count, error state
Link New Account button opens Plaid Link flow
Owner assignment: dropdown to assign linked accounts to a family member
Re-link button for Items in error state (generates update-mode link_token)
Remove institution button (deletes Item + cascades to accounts/transactions)
Manual sync trigger button per Item

userStories.title: Update mode for broken connections
acceptanceCriteria: Items with ITEM_LOGIN_REQUIRED or similar errors show re-link prompt
Re-link uses Plaid Link in update mode (existing access_token)
On success, Item status resets to 'good', error_code cleared
Next sync proceeds normally

high: OAuth redirect URI must exactly match Plaid dashboard config — any mismatch fails silently
medium: Cloudflare Tunnel must be running during OAuth flows — add health check
link_token expires after 4 hours — OAuth sessions that take longer will fail
low: Sandbox mode doesn't exercise real OAuth — production testing required for Chase

preFlightChecklist: Cloudflare Tunnel running on erebor with plaid-callback.forbell.com routing to localhost:3003
Redirect URI registered in Plaid Dashboard: https://plaid-callback.forbell.com/oauth/callback
All target institutions approved in Plaid Compliance Center
